info.name: 4D Cross Product
info.description:
Finding a 4th vector perpendicular to three other vectors in 4D.
Right/Left arrow keys to yaw
Up/Down arrow keys to pitch
Q/E keys to roll
W/A/S/D to select axis of rotation (W: w axis, A: x axis, S: y axis, D: z axis)
R key to toggle auto rotation
